reading.text: Children are the men and women of the future; we should begin with good children. We should give children good food, good health and good education. They should be given the chance to practice exercises and sport to build their bodies. We should teach them how to love, give and help. We should set the examples for our children in what we say and what we do.

questions.question: Why should we care about our children?
questions.verifiedAnswer: They are the men and women of the future.

questions.question: What does a child need?
questions.verifiedAnswer: Good food, good health, good education, and the chance to practise exercises and sport.

reading.text: It's spring. The sun is shining and the fields and garden are full of flowers for the animals and insects to eat. It's a lovely day. The bee are buzzing and the butterflies are flying in the sun. The ants, however, are working hard. The lazy grasshopper spends most of his time relaxing. He doesn't like to work. today, he is resting against a tree when he heard strange sound. He wants to find out what it is. He looks over the garden fence and finds an ant working. He asks the ant to play together, but the ant refuses because she has to work hard.

reading.text: Egypt is a sunny country, making it ideal for solar energy. One important project is Benban Solar Park near Aswan. It is one of the largest solar stations in the world. The park uses millions of solar panels to make clean electricity for homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Benban also creates many jobs for engineers, builders, and local workers. This helps families in Upper Egypt earn money and have a better life. By using the power of the sun instead of oil and gas, Benban reduces pollution and protects the environment. It is a proud step toward a greener future for Egypt.

questions.question: How does Benban Solar Park help people who live in Upper Egypt?
questions.verifiedAnswer: It creates jobs for engineers, builders, and local workers, helping families earn money and have a better life.

questions.question: Why is using the sun better than using oil and gas for energy?
questions.verifiedAnswer: It reduces pollution and protects the environment.
